say:8:1422120104:0.text: My sweet Lolde, you've made me happier than I've ever been...
say:8:1422120104:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪，我从没有像现在这样幸福过……

say:9:1422120105:0.text: Every day with you feels like a warm, fluffy dream...
say:9:1422120105:0.source_cn: 和你在一起的每一天，都像生活在巨大的肥皂泡幻影里……

say:10:1422120106:0.text: You don't make me feel like a lowly servant but a real woman of flesh and blood!
say:10:1422120106:0.source_cn: 你让我觉得，我不再是卑贱的仆从，被随意驱使的杂役，无足...

say:11:1422120107:0.text: After all these years of working tirelessly in this vast city, I've finally left a mark—not on the streets or the skyline, but with you, in your heart.
say:11:1422120107:0.source_cn: 在这偌大的、我为之不停劳作的王城里，我第一次留下了存在...

say:12:1422120108:0.text: But how long will these happy, careless days last...? I dare not think about it.
say:12:1422120108:0.source_cn: 可这样幸福的日子会持续多久呢……？我不敢细想。

say:13:1422120109:0.text: You once asked me if I cared about all things that stand in our way... Yes, I care and fear for our future...
say:13:1422120109:0.source_cn: 你曾经问过我，是否还介意那些阻挡我们的东西？其实我介意...

say:14:1422120110:0.text: We come from different worlds, you and I. And trust me, I know better than you what happens to those of low birth who dare to love the nobility. It's a path I wouldn't wish on anyone.
say:14:1422120110:0.source_cn: 我和你生活在不一样的世界里，我比你更清楚那些和贵族恋爱...

say:16:1422120112:0.text: Oh, my sweet Lolde, until death takes me and makes us part ways...
say:16:1422120112:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪，直到死亡把我带走，把我们分开之前……

say:17:1422120113:0.text: Let a piece of me linger in your heart... A whisper of forever...
say:17:1422120113:0.source_cn: 在你心里，留下我存在过的痕迹吧……

say:20:1422120114:0.text: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...
say:20:1422120114:0.source_cn: 原来艾莎从来没有后悔过……
say:20:1422120114:0.male: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...
say:20:1422120114:0.female: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...

say:21:1422120115:0.text: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.
say:21:1422120115:0.source_cn: 我们把这枚戒指……留在这里吧。
say:21:1422120115:0.male: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.
say:21:1422120115:0.female: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 它无意间记录了主人最强烈的记忆

choice:2:0:1.text: The magic on the ring is connected here.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 戒指上残留的魔力对这里有感应
choice:2:0:1.male: The magic on the ring is connected here.
choice:2:0:1.female: The magic on the ring is connected here.
